# GitHub Copilot instructions

UF-CSS is a **brand-independent** design foundation. Follow `AGENTS.md` and the skill in `.agents/skills/universal-foundation-css/SKILL.md` when planning or auditing design systems.

Use the existing seven-domain architecture; no UI library or company-specific design language belongs in this core package. Respect accessibility, document grid selection, add tests for pure formula changes, and report actual verification.
